gate3.note: No new core filter or entry rule was added. The pressure resilience candidate source is additive default-off paper, so core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate-pool alpha: after broad cross-sectional pressure, liquid sector-known stocks that stay resilient versus SPY/QQQ may be cleaner next-open paper candidates than raw momentum.

2_history_check.exp-20260528-035/036: Sector/industry breadth breakout variants were rejected; this test uses market-wide pressure plus single-day resilience instead of broad sector breadth agreement.
2_history_check.exp-20260605-013: Broad low-beta residual momentum candidate pool was rejected due PnL loss, two window regressions, and drawdown deterioration.
2_history_check.exp-20260605-023: Observed-only breadth alignment did not show a stable monotonic ladder.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Same three canonical windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive; no EV/PnL regression window; at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows; survival >=5%; drawdown drift <=0.5pp; concentration pass.

hypothesis: Cross-sectional pressure days may reveal higher-quality broad candidates: stocks that stay liquid, close strong, and outperform SPY/QQQ during broad synchronous stress can produce default-off next-open paper alpha without adding noisy tickers.
interpretation: The pressure-resilience candidate source did not clear Gate 4. Do not promote or retry this fixed OHLCV pressure/resilience definition on the same frozen windows without a materially new PIT state field or forward replacement-value data.
next_evidence_needed: A retry needs a materially new PIT state field, such as real-time breadth/changepoint persistence or cost-adjusted replacement rows; do not simply retune pressure thresholds, hold days, cooldown, or paper notional on this frozen sample.

prediction.confidence_reason: Recent broad OHLCV candidate pools mostly failed, but cross-sectional pressure plus resilience is a materially different production-visible state variable and can be tested replay-only with strict gates.

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result would require a shared default-off adapter that computes the same broad warehouse cross-sectional pressure fields, sector-known liquidity universe, same-day core overlap exclusion, next-open paper entry, 10-trading-day exit, costs, cooldown, and concentration controls in both replay and daily production before any report queue, paper ledger, candidate priority, sizing, watchlist, or order surface could change.
